Bugzilla answer review

How to review

  1. Pick Needs human review on the left. These are answers the computer could not grade (time questions and explanations).
  2. Compare Method answer with the Correct answer. For hours, a difference of up to 1 hour still counts as correct.
  3. Open Evidence given to the method and decide whether those snippets back up the answer. Choose Not applicable only when the method gave no answer.
  4. Add a short note and click Save and next.
  5. Then do Needs evidence check. These were already graded automatically; you only judge the evidence.
  6. When finished, click Download CSV and run scripts\run_phase11_evaluation.ps1 --import-review PATH_TO_CSV to update the official scores.

Shortcuts: Y correct, X incorrect, S supported, U unsupported, C unclear, N not applicable, Ctrl+Enter save, J/K next or previous response.

Your decisions are saved in this browser as you go. Download the CSV to keep a copy.
